scripts.dev:start: pnpm exec concurrently -k -n BACKEND,WEB -c blue,green "docker compose up --build" "pnpm dev:web"
scripts.prod:deploy: docker compose up -d --build && docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/app -w /app node:22-alpine sh -lc "corepack enable && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @report-platform/web build" && mkdir -p /var/www/report-platform && rm -rf /var/www/report-platform/* && cp -r apps/web/dist/. /var/www/report-platform/ && systemctl reload nginx
